free_tier.stated: Free 2 vCPU / 2 GiB / 20 GB cloud server in Los Angeles on CN2 GIA, China Unicom 9929 and China Mobile CMIN2 return routes, quoted as 美国2H2G 云服务器 免费领取 最高可领10年 (a US 2H2G cloud server, free, claimable for up to ten years). The first grant is three days; renewal is earned through the referral programme. The paid ladder starts at CNY 199 a year for 8 vCPU / 8 GiB / 50 GB SSD / 20 Mbps.

chaining: A free 2 GiB box on premium China-return routes is a cheap origin for a proxy front, and it composes with any free IPv4 tunnel for inbound; the renewal loop is what breaks it.

limits.value: The machine runs three days and renewal is earned by recruiting, so the free tier is a promotion loop rather than a standing allowance; a user who does not bring in referrals loses the box every three days.
